name: In Court
overview: Reality program that follows the confrontations between judge and citizen in various courts in the Netherlands. In a court case, the stakes are always high. There is always something on the line for the suspect, the victim, or a citizen seeking justice. The individuals who stand face to face with the judge are followed closely throughout the proceedings and hear the verdict directly at the end. Experts weigh in on the cases with interesting facts and explain how the judge reaches their decision.
